subject: Cost and Management Accounting
question_text:
12.  A company produces two joint products X and Y, using the same type of
material. The cost data to produce 200 units of product X and 400 units of
product Y are as under:
Material
` 80,000
Labour
` 40,000
Fixed overheads
` 20,000

Sales of product X was 200 units @` 350 per unit and product Y was 400
units @ ` 250 per unit.

Using the Contribution margin method, in what ratio fixed overheads will be
apportioned between Product X and Product Y?
(A)  4:8
(B)  3:2

6
(C)  2:3
(D)  8:4
(2 Marks)
